14. He also submits that the Ain, 2013 incorporated the various provisions to meet the challenge of the Co-operatives are presumed to be constitutionally valid law and the legislature by applying its wisdom enacted the AM, 2013, keeping conformity to the Constitution and the Ain, 2001. He further submits that mere assertion that the Ain, 2013 is unconstitutional is not enough but heavy burden lies upon the petitioner to prove that some of provisions of the Ain, 2013 were repugnant to the Constitution and the scheme of the Ain, 2001. 

 22. In view of the presumption of the constitutionality of laws and State action, the burden of proof showing that a provision of law or State action is violative of any fundamental rights is on the person who alleges it. In discharging the burden the allegation of person aggrieved in writ petition must be specific, clear and unambiguous disclosing how a right has been infringed and he must present relevant materials in support of the allegation made there under.
